customManagers.description: Update every Skills CLI pin together, so installs and removals run the same version. The installer tests read theirs from link.sh, since Renovate ignores tests/
Pin each external skill to the last commit on its branch that changed its folder, so commits elsewhere in the repository don't propose an update

Check that each skill's folder still exists on its branch. The commit lookup above keeps finding the commit that moved or deleted a folder, so this lookup fails instead, which flags the stale path on the Dependency Dashboard and in Renovate's pull requests

github-folder.description: The newest commit that changed a folder. A folder with no history, such as a misspelt path, fails the lookup instead of offering nothing

github-folder-exists.description: The branch itself, offered only while the folder exists on it, so the lookup never proposes an update but fails once the folder is gone

packageRules.description: Propose skill instruction changes weekly for manual review
Link each update to the upstream commit comparison
